код: new Promise(res=>{const r=indexedDB.open("показ");r.onsuccess=()=>{const db=r.result;const names=[...db.objectStoreNames];const out={v:db.version,stores:{}};const tx=db.transaction(names,"readonly");let left=names.length;names.forEach(n=>{const st=tx.objectStore(n);const q=st.getAll();const qk=st.getAllKeys();q.onsuccess=()=>{qk.onsuccess=()=>{out.stores[n]={keyPath:st.keyPath,auto:st.autoIncrement,n:q.result.length,keys:qk.result.slice(0,20).map(String),types:q.result.slice(0,5).map(v=>Object.prototype.toString.call(v)+":"+(typeof v==="string"?v.length:JSON.stringify(v).length))};if(--left==0)res(out);};};});};})
